Pierline Property Management. Corrected check-out report: Unit 4B, 27 Harbor Street.
Issued on Monday 9 November 2026 by Dana Whitlock, Managing Agent.
This page corrects the check-out inspection report for Unit 4B that was completed on 10 March 2026. It is issued after a review of our front desk book, in which our staff write down every key that is handed in or found in the drop box.
The unit keys for 4B were received at our office on 27 February 2026. Both sets were found in our drop box that afternoon and were written in the front desk book on the same day, with the entry fob.
The date of 6 March 2026 in the first report is the date on which the keys were filed with the report, not the date on which they were returned.
The mailbox key was handed in separately on 9 March 2026, as the first report says. Nothing else in the first report is changed by this page.
We apologise for the error. A copy of this page has been sent to Mr Ellison, to Ms Ortiz and to the tribunal.
Dana Whitlock, Managing Agent, Pierline Property Management

Sam Okafor, plumbing and heating, Port Maren. Job sheet and invoice no. 0117.
Copy issued on 9 November 2026 at the request of the customer.
Customer: Mark Ellison, Unit 4B, 27 Harbor Street, Port Maren. Work agreed with the owner, L Ortiz, by text message to the customer, as shown to me on the customer's phone.
Work done: attended Unit 4B on 24 January 2026 at 09:30. Found water coming through the bathroom ceiling above the bath. Traced it to a loose joint on the waste pipe from the flat above, reached through the ceiling hatch in 4B. Tightened and resealed the joint as a temporary repair.
First attendance at Unit 4B: 24 January 2026.
Advice to the customer: the ceiling board above the bath is wet through and should be replaced once it has dried out. The joint above should be replaced, not just resealed, by the building's own contractor.
Labour, two and a half hours: $250.00. Parts, joint seal and sealant: $130.00. Total: $380.00. Paid by bank transfer on 29 January 2026, with thanks.
Sam Okafor
